A '''phone''' was a communications device that permitted two or more users to conduct a conversation when they were not in the same vicinity of each other to be heard directly. They were found in many public places on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], such as the area around the top of the mountain [[Umate/Legends|Umate]],<ref name="Duchess" /> in the [[Lower market districts/Legends|lower market districts]],<ref name="Evil Plans">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref> and one of the areas affected by the power outage caused by the [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref>
